dag_validation.validation_method: Topological sort completed without back-edge detection. All 24 nodes ordered.

critical_path.rationale: Longest unconditional chain from T0.1 to T6.4. The Phase 4 fork (T1.3 → T4.1 → T4.2 → T6.1) is shorter than the Phase 2 + Phase 3 chain through T2.1 → T2.2 → T2.3 → T3.1 → T3.2 → T3.6 → T5.1 → T6.1. The T3.1→T3.2→T3.6 path is the critical sub-chain within Phase 3 because T3.2 depends on T3.1 and converges at T3.6 alongside the parallel T3.3/T3.4/T3.5 cluster.
critical_path.estimated_focused_effort_along_critical_: ~13-16 hours (excluding T6.3 multi-hour pipeline cycle time and excluding operator wait-time at T6.2 session restart)

parallelizable_clusters.rationale: Both depend only on T0.1; no shared writers (T0.2 → open-items.md; T0.3 → rollback-baseline.txt).

After T1.3 completes, T2.1 (Phase 2 entry, edits SKILL.md) and T4.1 (Phase 4 entry, edits state-transitions-log-entry-template.md) have no shared writers. Phase 4 (T4.1 → T4.2) runs in parallel with Phase 2 (T2.1 → T2.2 → T2.3) and Phase 3.

All four fan out from T2.3 and edit distinct files (no shared writers — T3.1: execute-orchestrator.md; T3.3: execute-finalize-reconciler.md; T3.4: execute-task-code-producer.md; T3.5: execute-task-quality-handler.md + execute-phase-quality-reviewer.md). T3.2 must follow T3.1 sequentially (same file). All four converge at T3.6 bundled commit.
Identical pattern, independent files; can be authored concurrently. Explicitly called out in orchestrator brief as specialist-body-prose-update pair.

cross_phase_parallel_branches.rationale: Phase 4 forks off after T1.3 and runs concurrently with Phases 2+3; both branches converge at T6.1 (which requires both T5.1 and T4.2).

ac_coverage_summary.verification_coverage_note: All 28 in-plan ACs have ≥ 1 task and ≥ 1 acceptance test. 4 satisfied-upstream ACs are gated by PV-0.C5 (which verifies the T-001 research note still exists with required flags). 3 vacuous-by-kc2 ACs are verified by absence-of-trigger tests (T-AC-FR-2-a/b/c).

test_coverage_summary.tests_bound_to_at_least_one_task: all tests bound; satisfied-upstream + vacuous-by-kc2 tests are not bound to in-plan tasks but are referenced by PV-0.C5 (upstream) and verified-by-absence at Phase 6 (vacuous)
test_coverage_summary.test_implementation_tasks_required: Not required — all tests in acceptance-tests.md are file-existence / grep / structural-parse / git-log / behavioral checks executable against artifacts produced by the 24 in-plan tasks. No separate `test-implementation` task class is required because tests are runnable as phase-validator-shell-script invocations against the existing artifacts.

validator_coverage_summary.validator_setup_tasks_required: Not required — Phase Validators are documented as shell-script + Python one-liner checks in phase-validators.md. The validator-runbook in phase-validators.md §Validator runbook is the operator-facing invocation guide. No separate validator-setup tasks are dispatched; validator execution is the Phase boundary check performed by the parent recipe-feature-pipeline orchestrator (or by the operator running `bash phase-validator.sh PV-N`).

agent_dispatch_policy.convention: Per ADR-0044 (flatten dispatch hierarchy): tasks specify `agent_dispatch_hint: execute-task-code-producer` but are dispatched by the parent `recipe-feature-pipeline` skill at main-conversation level, NOT by `execute-orchestrator` (which is now an advisor per Phase 3 re-scoping).
agent_dispatch_policy.agent_tool_grant_prohibition_reference: ADR-0045 — sub-agents in this project MUST NOT declare `Agent` in their `tools:` array. This tasks.json's dispatch_hint values are advisory metadata, not runtime tool grants; the parent skill is the dispatcher.

open_items_for_orchestrator.description: T6.2 carries `forced_session_boundary: true` — a tasks.json-level constraint not explicitly named in the Plan's prose. The Plan's text (Cross-Phase Sequencing Constraint 3) describes the F-7 fresh-session gate as a load-bearing operator action; the tasks.json encodes this as a machine-readable flag so the downstream execution-side runtime knows not to dispatch T6.3 in the same session as the Phase-3 edits. This is a faithful encoding of the Plan's intent, not a new constraint.
